messages:
alejandra: Quick sync — pricing page experiment plan for next week. Goal: tighten tier names, refresh FAQ with use-case first answers, and pilot a small calculator on /pricing. staged posts + webinar teaser rather than one big launch.

rachel: sounds good. can we limit FAQ edits to top 6 questions and add a single flow clarifying Dedicated vs Private? short bullets only.

sam: propose KPIs: pricing->signup conversion, calculator clicks, and inbound leads tagged for Sales Ops. lightweight metrics.

dom: who owns tier-name copy? we tried 'Core / Scale / Enterprise' and it underperformed. suggest testing 'Developer / Production / Enterprise' — clearer signal to engineering buyers.

mike: +1 on Developer/Production. add a 1-line microcopy under each tier: "Built for X" to clarify intent.

nina: for calculator, include a "committed usage" toggle to show savings and an example autofill for 50k tokens/month.

beth_cs: CS can handle routing. auto-tag leads that select Dedicated/Private with "enterprise-interest" and send to Zendesk + Sales Ops queue.

alejandra: webinar: 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. hosts: rachel + dom; sam covers pricing. date options Tue 2/14 or Thu 2/16.

rachel: prefer Thu 2/16. i'll write registration copy. need a benchmark line: "customers reduced inference unit cost 3x using batching + cache" — sam, can you provide an anonymized stat?

sam: internal test shows ~2.8x unit cost reduction on long-tail prompts. i'll draft the blurb and send to legal to anonymize.

dom: launch cadence: 1) blog post (benchmark + product update), 2) LinkedIn/X thread (tier names + calculator), 3) webinar signup. space posts 48-72h apart.

mike: tracking: utm=pricing-experiment, campaign=pricing-relaunch, variant=A/B (tiernames), plus experiment id for analytics.

alejandra: owners: copy=rachel, calc+UX=mike, CS routing=beth_cs, legal signoff=nina, blog=dom, webinar ops=sam. who pairs with mike on calculator integration?

rachel: i can pair Wed AM for microcopy + FAQ strings.

mike: wed am works. i'll deliver a lightweight React widget. proto payload: ```json
{
  "monthly_tokens": 50000,
  "commitment": "none",
  "tier": "Developer"
}
```

beth_cs: CS needs final field list by Thu EOD to map inbound fields to Zendesk tags.

nina: legal needs the benchmark blurb and anonymized numbers; sam pls drop test doc in Drive.

sam: sharing doc by EOD. note: bench ran on GPU-optimized serving; i'll generalize wording to avoid cloud-specific mentions.

alejandra: timeline: Wed AM pair on calc+FAQ, Thu morning final copy review, Thu noon legal signoff, Thu 4pm publish to staging, Fri AM soft email to beta customers, Mon open webinar registration.

dom: can product add a short in-console banner for accounts likely to benefit? product needs 48h lead.

mike: need banner copy + CTA. rachel, can you draft 1-liner?

rachel: "New pricing experiments: clearer tiers and an interactive estimator — try the estimator" CTA: "Try estimator"

deploy-bot: Reminder: add deploy tag `pricing-experiment/v1` to staging release notes when publishing.

alejandra: final: run A/B on tier names for 3 weeks, then evaluate. sam owns evaluation deck, dom writes blog, rachel runs webinar copy + posts, beth_cs owns inbound routing. blockers?

nina: none after i review sam's doc.

beth_cs: will reuse inbound schema but need mapping doc.

sam: follow-up: instrument events pricing_page_view, calculator_open, calculator_submit, lead_tagged. we'll include them in the experiment schema.

mike: noted, setting up event schema now.

alejandra: next check-in Wed 10:00am PT. thanks all :raised_hands:
